performance.label: Custom
performance.description: Keep a separate set of launch options.

decode.label: Force video decoding
decode.description: Use the GPU to play videos.

encode.label: Force video encoding
encode.description: Use the GPU to encode videos.

nvidiaVaapi.label: Allow VA-API on NVIDIA GPUs
nvidiaVaapi.description: Use NVIDIA's VA-API driver to decode supported video formats.

forceAcceleration.label: Force acceleration
forceAcceleration.description: Use the GPU even when driver checks block it.

softwareDecode.label: Software video decoding
softwareDecode.description: Use the CPU to play videos. HEVC playback requires hardware decoding.

softwareRaster.label: Software rasterization
softwareRaster.description: Use the CPU to draw page content. May increase CPU use.

driverWorkarounds.label: Skip driver fixes
driverWorkarounds.description: Turn off workarounds for known GPU bugs.
